about: Lesson 1.07 task suites. Each case carries the stand-in model's candidate completions with a logit per candidate -- its relative preference before sampling (sampling_lab.py, rule 1). Extraction and grading cases carry a gold; brainstorming cases carry no gold, only one candidate flagged offbrief per prompt. Logits are the model's judgement; the lesson measures what the sampling settings do with it.
